source: 630 Day Tour
target: Iter diurnum 630

source: The nearly three‐meter‐tall giant expressed regret,
target: Gigante, paene tres metra altus, paenitentiam expressit,

source: “The six‐member council mandates that we can’t discuss matters not mentioned in the Holy Bible.
target: “Consilium sex membrorum imperat ut de rebus, quae in Sancta Biblia non commemoratae sunt, non loqui possimus.

source: As a believer of Mr. Fool, you must be familiar with the sermons and official statements.
target: Ut credulus Domini Stulti, sermonibus et declarationibus officialibus notus esse debes.

source: I can’t share anything beyond that, just as I can’t claim to have personally seen the Angel of Redemption and received his assistance.”
target: Ultra nihil aliud communicare possum, sicut neque affirmare possum me Angelum Redemptoris perspexisse aut eius auxilium adeptum esse.”

source: Attempting to tap Lumian on the shoulder, the “giant” found Lumian deftly dodging the gesture.
target: Ad Lumiano in umero tetigendum conatur, sed gigas eum callide ictum vitare invenit.

source: “How should I address you?” Lumian, feigning reverence, inquired, not fully convinced.
target: “Quomodo tibi dicam?” Lumian, reverentiam simulans, percontatus est, nondum plene persuasus.

source: The “giant” responded, “Livalie.
target: Gigas respondit, “Livalie.

source: “A toast to the newborn of the City of Silver!”
target: “Ad honorem recenter natum Urbis Argenteae!”

source: Lumian raised his massive beer glass, clinking it against the other party’s.
target: Lumian magnum poculum cervisiae attollit, cum poculo alterius tintinnabulum faciens.

source: Then, he downed the remaining golden liquid.
target: Deinde reliquam liquidum aureum deglutivit.

source: Rubbing his bulging stomach, he gestured towards the washroom, indicating his need to relieve himself.
target: Venter eius tumidus fricens, ad latrinam indicavit, necessitatem se evacuandi declarans.

source: The beer in the New City of Silver wasn’t extraordinary, but the cups were simply too large.
target: Cervisia in Nova Urbe Argentea non extraordinaria erat, sed pocula nimis magna erant.

source: After two glasses, Lumian’s physique and alcohol tolerance reached their limit.
target: Post duas pocula, corporis statura Lumiani et tolerantia alcoholica finem attigerunt.

source: He wasn’t drunk; he was just stuffed!
target: Non ebrius fuit; solum saturatus erat!

source: Entering the washroom, Lumian stood before one of the urinals, unbuckling his belt and narrowing his eyes.
target: In latrinam ingrediens, Lumian coram uno latrinali stetit, cingulum solvens et oculos contrahens.

source: Amidst the splashing sounds, a “giant” more than three meters tall entered and chose the urinal beside him.
target: Inter sonos aquae fragminos, gigas plus quam tres metra altus intravit et latrinam iuxta se optavit.

source: Lumian subconsciously turned his head before slowly retracting his gaze.
target: Lumian instinctu caput vertit, deinde lente oculos avertit.

source: Dazed, he stared at the wall in front of him until the pressure in his abdomen completely subsided.
target: Stupefactus, murum ante se contemplatus est, donec pressio in abdomine eius prorsus defecit.

source: Only then did he leave the washroom, returning to his usual seat at the bar counter.
target: Tunc tantum latrinam reliquit et ad sedem solitam ad mensam tabernae rediit.

source: Livalie had already ordered a new glass of beer for Lumian.
target: Livalie iam novum poculum cervisiae Lumiano constituerat.

source: It was dark‐black but not murky.
target: Erat obscurum nigerrimum, sed non turbide.

source: Swirling in the mug, it revealed a hint of brown.
target: Circumvolvens in poculo, levem fusci colorem revelavit.

source: “Try it.”
target: “Experire.”

source: “It’s a specialty of the New City of Silver, Black‐Faced Beer!”
target: “Est specialitas Novae Urbis Argenteae, Cervisia Faciei Nigratae!”

source: the “giant,” firmly believing himself to be human, introduced enthusiastically.
target: Gigas, se humanum esse firmiter creditus, alacriter enunciavit.

source: “Black‐Faced Beer?” Lumian, holding the beer glass larger than his head, asked in puzzlement.
target: “Cervisia Faciei Nigratae?” Lumian, poculum cervisiae maius quam caput tenens, percontatus est.

source: Livalie suddenly felt a pang of sadness.
target: Livalie subito dolorem tristicum sensit.

source: “The Forsaken Land of the Gods lacked the sun and fertile soil.
target: “Terra deorum relicta solem et terram fecundam carebat.

source: Only Black‐Faced Grass grew.
target: Solum herba Faciei Nigratae crescebat.

source: It was our staple, sustaining generations of City of Silver residents.
target: Illud erat cibus nostrum praecipuus, generationes incolarum Urbis Argenteae alens.

source: Though always insufficient, it was better than nothing.
target: Etsi semper insufficiente, melius quam nihil erat.

source: Back then, brewing alcohol from Black‐Faced Grass was impossible.
target: Illo tempore, alcohol ex herba Faciei Nigratae fabricari impossibile erat.

source: It was too, too extravagant.
target: Erat nimis, nimis extravagantum.

source: Heh heh, now with food, meat, and milk in abundance, I’ve grown taller again.
target: Heh heh, nunc cum cibo, carne, et lacte abundantibus, iterum altior factus sum.

source: I’m 30 centimeters taller than before.”
target: Triginta centimetris altior sum quam antea.”

source: “Can Black‐Faced Grass still be planted in the New City of Silver?
target: “Num herba Faciei Nigratae adhuc in Nova Urbe Argentea plantari potest?

source: Grown underground?”
target: Num sub terra crescitur?

source: Although Lumian wasn’t a Planter, having grown up in the countryside, he knew that in extreme environments, those plants might not survive under normal circumstances.
target: Quamquam Lumian plantator non fuit, cum in rure educatus esset, sciebat in condicionibus extremis illae plantae sub ordinariis casibus non superesse posse.

source: Livalie smiled.
target: Livalie subridit.

source: “It can be planted!
target: “Plantari potest!

source: It can grow in any environment.
target: In quolibet ambitu crescere potest.

source: Of course, we’ve had someone modify the Black‐Faced Grass seeds to make them more suitable for the current conditions.
target: Certe, aliquis semina herbae Faciei Nigratae mutavit, ut ad condiciones actuales melius convenirent.

source: Its texture is actually quite different from before.
target: Textura eius revera plane diversa est quam antea.

source: Even more flavorful.
target: Etiam sapidior.

source: Give it a try.
target: Experire.

source: You won’t find this beer elsewhere.
target: Hanc cervisiam alibi non reperies.

source: We don’t grow much ourselves.
target: Nos ipsi parum colimus.

source: It’s mainly to remember the past.”
target: Praecipue ad praeterita commemoranda est.

source: Lumian raised the beer glass to his lips with interest, taking a large gulp.
target: Lumian poculum cervisiae ad labra cum studio levavit, et magnum sorbuit.

source: The first thing he tasted was the normal, faint fragrance of wheat.
target: Primum quod gustavit, odor solitus et lenis tritici erat.

source: Then, he experienced a refreshing grass-like stimulation in the sweet alcohol.
target: Deinde, in dulci alcoholo, sensum refrigerantem, similem graminis, sensit.

source: Finally, a subtle milky taste filled his mouth.
target: Demum, subtiles lacteus gustus os eius replevit.

source: “Not bad.
target: “Non male.

source: It’s a special and wonderful experience.”
target: Experientia praecipua et mirabilis est.”

source: Lumian was generous with his praise.
target: Lumian laude sua largus erat.

source: Curious, he inquired, “Do you have any liquor brewed from Black‐Faced Grass?”
target: Curiosus, rogavit, “Habesne liquor ex herba Faciei Nigratae confectus?”

source: Livalie’s expression darkened as he shook his head.
target: Vultus Livaliei obscuratus est, dum caput negabat.

source: “We in the New City of Silver consider alcoholism debased, indulgent, and a waste of food.
target: “Nos in Nova Urbe Argentea ebrietatem putamus depravatam, indulgentem, et cibum prodigus consumentem,

source: That’s why we reject liquor.”
target: idcirco liquor recusamus.”

source: At this point, he paused.
target: In eo momento, moratus est.

source: “Besides, Black‐Faced Grass doesn’t seem suitable for brewing.
target: “Praeterea, herba Faciei Nigratae non videtur ad potionem conficiendam apta esse.

source: Even if it’s made into beer, drinking too much will cause hallucinations.
target: Etiamsi in cervisiam redigatur, nimis bibere hallucinationes provocabit.

source: I can only handle three glasses at a time.”
target: Tres tantum pocula simul tolerare possum.”

source: Minor toxicity?
target: Toxica parva?

source: In the Forsaken Land of the Gods, people from the New City of Silver relied on eating this plant to survive generation after generation.
target: In Terra deorum relicta, incolae Novae Urbis Argenteae in hanc herbam comedendo generationes superaverunt.

source: It wasn’t easy…
target: Non facile fuit…

source: Lumian recalled his sister’s occasional jokes and smirked.
target: Lumian iocos sororis occasionales recordatus est et subridens arridit.

source: “If you drink too much, will you see a group of little people dancing?”
target: “Si nimis biberis, num turmam parvarum hominum saltantium videbis?”

source: Livalie pondered for a moment and replied, “No, hallucinations are usually different.
target: Livalie paulisper meditatus est et respondit, “Non, hallucinationes plerumque aliter sunt.

source: Some see their wives slapping them, some hear the cries of their deceased relatives, and some find a baby lying by the roadside wailing…”
target: Quidam uxores suas verberari vident, quidam clamores cognatorum defunctorum audiunt, et quidam infantem ad viam iacentem ululantem inveniunt…”

source: Lumian couldn’t bear to hear about matters involving babies crying, so he lost interest and focused on the taste of the Black‐Faced Beer.
target: Lumian audiendi rationes de infantulis plorantibus ferre non potuit, itaque studium amisit et ad saporem Cervisiae Faciei Nigratae se concentravit.

source: After finishing the glass, he made another trip to the washroom before leaving the bar.
target: Poculum confecto, aliam iter ad latrinam fecit antequam tabernam relinqueret.

source: He planned to take advantage of the afternoon sun to stroll around New Silver City and teleport back to the Berries docked at Port Hanth in the evening.
target: Eum consilium erat ut solis postmeridiani luce frueretur ambulans per Novam Urbem Argenteam, et vesperi ad Berries, quae in Portu Hanth fixa erant, celeriter rediret.

source: In the sparsely populated yet unusually towering buildings, half-giants roamed.
target: In aedificiis raram incolis sed insolito altis, semigigantes vagabantur.

source: Every now and then, one or two “giants” standing over three meters tall could be spotted.
target: Interdum, uno vel duobus gigantibus, qui plus quam tres metra altitudinis erant, deprehendi poterunt.

source: Those below 1.8 meters were a rarity, except for those with child-like faces.
target: Qui minus quam 1.8 metra erant, rarissimi erant, nisi cum vultu puerili.

source: Lumian’s stature barely met the criteria, and his eyes quickly scanned the surroundings.
target: Statura Lumiani vix conveniebat criteriis, et oculi eius celeriter circumspectabant.

source: He observed turquoise vines snaking up the outer walls of certain houses.
target: Animadvertit vitis caeruleasque, serpentinas, in parietibus exterioribus quarundam domorum ascendere.

source: On these vines, numerous soft, large, white, and plump mushrooms thrived.
target: In his vitibus, multas fungos, molles, magnos, albos, et plenissimos vigere.

source: Mushrooms?
target: Fungi?

source: Since when did vines yield mushrooms?
target: Ex quo tempore vitis fungos producere coeperunt?

source: Lumian furrowed his brow, questioning his botanical knowledge.
target: Lumian supercilia contraxit, et de sua scientia botanica quaesivit.

source: It occurred to him that this might be a unique plant brought from the Forsaken Land of the Gods by the New City of Silver, bringing a sense of relief.
target: Ei visa est hanc plantam unicam esse, quae a Nova Urbe Argentea ex Terra deorum relicta adlata sit, levamen praebens.

source: He approached a roadside stall and glanced up.
target: Accessit ad iustam staitionem viariam et sursum illusit.

source: “You’re selling milk.
target: “Lactem vendis.

source: Why don’t I see a bucket of milk?”
target: Cur non video situlam lactis?

source: The vendor, standing at 2.56 meters with slightly grayish-blue skin, smiled genuinely and replied,
target: Venditor, 2.56 metris statuens, cutis paulo griseo-caerulea, sincere subridens respondit,

source: “The house behind me is mine.
target: “Domus post me mea est.

source: Want some milk?”
target: Visne aliquantulum lactis?

source: “I’ll take a glass.”
target: “Calicem accipiam.”

source: Lumian, having already inquired, had no qualms about purchasing a glass of milk; money was not an issue.
target: Lumian, iam perquisitus, nullas difficultates habuit ad emendum calicem lactis; pecunia non curabat.

source: Though verl d’or and gold risot weren’t official currency in the New City of Silver, gold held value universally.
target: Quamquam “verl d’or” et “gold risot” monetæ officiales in Nova Urbe Argentea non erant, aurum universale valorem habebat.

source: The vendor cheerfully grabbed a cup, turned around, and headed to his two-story house.
target: Venditor laete poculum arripuit, se vertit, et ad domum suam duorum tabulorum profectus est.

source: He reached out and plucked a soft, white mushroom.
target: Manum protulit et fungum mollem, album, evellit.

source: He aimed the mushroom at the cup and squeezed it.
target: Fungum in poculum proposuit et comprimit.

source: Milk-white liquid gushed out, rapidly filling the cup.
target: Liquidum lacteum ex albo effluens celeriter poculum implevit.

source: Lumian’s jaw dropped, confusion once again clouding his eyes.
target: Maxilla Lumiani decidit, et iterum confusio oculos eius nubilosos fecerat.

source: This is what you guys call milk?
target: Hocne est quod vos “lactem” vocatis?

source: “It’s ready.”
target: “Paratum est.”

source: The half-giant vendor handed the milk to Lumian.
target: Venditor semigigas lacte Lumiano tradidit.

source: Lumian instinctively took it and asked in bewilderment, “Are those mushrooms?”
target: Lumian instinctu id accepit et miratus rogavit, “Suntne illi fungi?”

source: “Yes, milk mushrooms,” the half-giant vendor replied earnestly.
target: “Ita, fungi lactei,” respondit venditor semigigas sincere.

source: You call that mushrooms?
target: Illos fungi vocatis?

source: Lumian paid in a daze and left the stall with a cup in hand.
target: Lumian in stupore solvit et tabernam cum poculo in manu reliquit.

source: He couldn’t recall how much he paid or even why he started the conversation about buying milk.
target: Non meminit quantum solveret, neque cur de emendo lacte colloquium incepisset.

source: After walking more than ten meters, he brought the cup to his lips and took a sip.
target: Postquam plus quam decem metra ambulavit, poculum ad labra attulit et sorbit.

source: It tasted like milk!
target: Sapor lactis erat!

source: Lumian finished the glass with a frown, finding nothing peculiar.
target: Lumian poculum finivit cum vultu tristis, nihil insolitum inveniens.

source: Yet, the liquid came from mushrooms!
target: Attamen, liquidum ex fungis provenit!

source: Just consider it a unique plant…
target: Considera hoc tam solum plantam singularem…

source: Just consider it a unique plant…
target: Iterum, considera hoc plantam unicam esse…

source: Lumian muttered, deciding not to try it again.
target: Lumian submurmuravit, statuens ne iterum id temptaret.

source: He feared that drinking too much might turn him into a milk producer himself!
target: Timebat nimis bibere se ipsum in producentem lactis vertere!

source: He continued to wander aimlessly along streets twice as wide as those in Port Hanth.
target: Per vias, quae bis latiores erant quam in Portu Hanth, sine cogitatione vagari continuavit.

source: Suddenly, another “half-giant” with slightly grayish-blue skin approached, holding a thick book and speaking with unusual enthusiasm, “My friend, would you be interested in hearing me introduce our beacon and savior…”
target: Subito, alter semigigas, cum cute paulo cinereo-caerulea, accessit, librum crassum tenens et insolito ardore loquens, “Amice, visne audire ut lucernam nostrum et salvatoriam enarrarem…?”

source: Lumian smiled, pressed his hand to his chest, and bowed.
target: Lumian subridens manum ad pectum pressit et inclinavit se.

source: “Praise The Fool!”
target: “Laudate Stultum!”

source: “Ah, a brother.”
target: “Ah, frater.”

source: The half-giant was both disappointed and delighted.
target: Semigigas et contristatus et laetatus est.

source: The two of them conversed in ancient Feysac, but Lumian had overheard New City of Silver residents occasionally speaking Jotun, a language that could stir supernatural powers.
target: Ambos in antiqua Feysac lingua colloquebantur, sed Lumian incolarum Novae Urbis Argenteae aliquando Jotun, linguam quae vires supernaturales excitare poterat, audivit.

source: “Are there usually foreigners here?” Lumian asked casually.
target: “Hic peregrini plerumque sunt?” Lumian leviter rogavit.

source: The half-giant smiled and replied, “We often have foreigners visiting, exploring, and sightseeing.
target: Semigigas subridens respondit, “Saepe peregrini nos visitant, explorant, et loca admirantur.

source: In the early years, some chose to settle here, but most eventually moved away.
target: In primis annis, quidam hic habitare maluerunt, sed plerique tandem discesserunt.

source: Living with us proved challenging for them.
target: Vivere nobiscum eis difficile fuit.

source: Heh heh, we’re too tall and not well-versed in the pleasures of life.”
target: Heh heh, nimis altos sumus et in voluptatibus vitae non periti.

source: With that, the half-giant took something from his pocket and handed it to Lumian.
target: Hoc factum, semigigas aliquid e sacco suo extraxit et Lumiano dedit.

source: “I’m pleased to have you as a guest in the New City of Silver.
target: “Gaudeo quod te ut hospitem in Nova Urbe Argentea habeam.

source: Try our locally made candy.”
target: Conare nostrum saccharatum locale factum!

source: It was a candy wrapped in thin blue–white paper.
target: Erat confectum caram, in tenue charta caeruleo–alba involutum.

source: Lumian didn’t hesitate.
target: Lumian non haesitavit.

source: He took it, tore off the wrapping, and popped the white candy into his mouth.
target: Id cepit, involutum eripuit, et confectum dulcem album in os intulit.

source: The rich milky aroma and smooth sweetness quickly unfolded on his tongue, creating a delightful experience.
target: Aroma lacteus opulentus et lenitas dulcedinis celeriter in lingua eius evoluta sunt, experientiam iucundam efficientes.

source: Milk flavor…
target: Sapor lacteus…

source: Lumian’s curiosity sparked as he inquired with a peculiar expression, “Is this milk candy?”
target: Curiositas Lumiani exorta est, dum vultu singulari percontatus est, “Estne hoc caramen lacte?”

source: “Yes,” the proselytizing half-giant replied with a smile.
target: “Ita,” respondit semigigas adhortatus subridente.

source: “What kind of milk did you use?” Lumian hadn’t anticipated ever asking such a question.
target: “Qualis lactis usus es?” Lumian hanc quaestionem nunquam exspectaverat.

source: The half-giant replied naturally, “Milk from the milk mushrooms.”
target: Semigigas naturaliter respondit, “Lacte ex fungis lacteis.”

source: Lumian held the milk candy in his mouth, torn between spitting it out or swallowing it.
target: Lumian caramen lacteum in ore retinebat, inter eo exspumandum aut ingestum indecisa.

source: He sensed the genuine warmth and enthusiasm when the other party shared the milk candy.
target: Sensit veram calorem et ardorem, cum alter particeps caramen lacteum communicavit.

source: As time passed, Lumian witnessed mushrooms with a cooked meat fragrance, mushrooms smelling like fish, and various peculiar mushrooms.
target: Cum tempus processisset, Lumian fungos observavit cuius odor carnes coctae, fungos qui piscis oluerent, et varias species fungorum peculiares.

source: His gaze turned lost as he observed the half-giants and giants joyfully sharing their food.
target: Oculi eius errabant, dum semigigantes et gigantes laete cibum inter se communicabant.

source: Unconsciously, he arrived at a corner of the New City of Silver.
target: Inconscius, ad angulum Novae Urbis Argenteae pervenit.

source: A towering building stood there.
target: Ibi stabat aedificium immanis.

source: It was split into two sections.
target: Divisum erat in duas partes.

source: On the left, a spire tower; on the right, a domed tower.
target: Sinistra parte, turris aculeata; dextro, turris cupulata.

source: The outer wall, standing 30 to 40 meters tall, was a grayish-white hue.
target: Murus exterior, triginta ad quadraginta metra altus, cinereo–albo color erat.

source: The Twin Towers?
target: Geminae Turrēs?

source: According to Livalie, the spire houses the library and other public facilities, while the domed tower serves as the council office for the ruling six‐member council of the New City of Silver…
target: Secundum Livalie, turris aculeata bibliothecam et alia communia loca continet, dum turris cupulata officium consilii regnantis sex membrorum Novae Urbis Argenteae fungitur…

source: There must be Sealed Artifacts and formidable individuals in such a place…
target: Ibi esse debent Res Sigillatae et personae formidabiles…

source: Lumian stood nearby, examining the imposing structure before him.
target: Lumian iuxta stabat, structurem imponentem coram se examinans.

source: His eyes moved across the domed tower and noticed black plants resembling hair growing from the cracks near the ground.
target: Oculi eius per turrim cupulata volitaverunt, et plantas negras, pilis similes, ex fissuris prope terram crescere animadvertit.

source: They hung there, swaying occasionally in the wind.
target: Ibi pendebant, interdum in vento oscillantes.

source: Lumian diverted his attention and headed towards the spire, eager to explore the books passed down in the New City of Silver, a human settlement existing in the Forsaken Land of the Gods for thousands of years.
target: Lumian animum vertit et versus turrim aculeatam se contulit, libellis in Nova Urbe Argentea traditis explorandis avidus, oppidum humanum in Terra deorum relicta per milia annorum existens.
